description: A composite (S)TEM figure of the initial microstructure of a duplex lightweight steel, combining STEM-EDS elemental maps, HRTEM lattice images, a dark-field TEM image and an inverse-FFT reconstruction. Panels (a1-a8) are STEM-EDS maps, all with a 100 nm scale bar: (a1) is the STEM reference image showing dark blocky precipitates in a grey matrix; (a2) Fe (red), (a3) Mn (green), (a4) Al (blue) and (a7) Ni (magenta) maps, in which Al and Ni are co-enriched in discrete blocky regions; (a5) C (yellow) and (a6) V (cyan) maps, in which V and C are enriched in small particles; (a8) is a combined Al+V+C+Ni overlay. (b) HRTEM image of a gamma/B2 interface crossed by a white dashed line, 2 nm scale bar, with an FFT inset indexed [011]gamma // [111]B2. (c) HRTEM image of an individual VC precipitate in the gamma matrix, 2 nm scale bar, with FFT inset indexed [011]gamma // [011]VC. (d) Dark-field TEM image formed from the L'12 superlattice reflection, 20 nm scale bar, with an inset SADP along [011]gamma showing weak superlattice spots. (e) Inverse-FFT image, 2 nm scale bar, with red circles marking homogeneously distributed L'12-type ordered nanodomains. The group argues that Al/Ni partition into B2 while V/C form VC precipitates, and that L'12 ordered nanodomains are dispersed throughout the austenite.

observations.observation: Panel (a1) is a STEM reference image showing dark blocky precipitates dispersed in a grey matrix, with a 100 nm scale bar.
In the STEM-EDS maps, Al (a4, blue) and Ni (a7, magenta) are co-enriched in the same discrete blocky regions, which the caption identifies as the B2 phase.
In the STEM-EDS maps, V (a6, cyan) and C (a5, yellow) are enriched inside small precipitate particles, consistent with VC.
The Fe (a2) and Mn (a3) maps show these elements spread across the mapped area rather than concentrated in the blocky precipitates.
Panel (b) is an HRTEM image of a gamma/B2 interface marked with a white dashed line; the FFT inset is indexed as [011]gamma // [111]B2, indicating a semi-coherent orientation relationship.
Panel (c) is an HRTEM image of an individual VC precipitate in the austenite matrix; the FFT inset is indexed [011]gamma // [011]VC, consistent with a coherent VC/austenite relationship.
The caption states that the B2 phase has a semi-coherent relationship with the austenite while the VC phase forms a coherent relationship with the austenite matrix.

Panel (d) is a dark-field TEM image taken from the L'12 superlattice reflection; the inset SADP was recorded along the [011]gamma zone axis and shows additional superlattice reflections, marked with a small circle, besides the primary austenite reflections.
The long-range-ordered domains in panel (d) appear as homogeneously distributed nanoscale particles in the austenite grain.
Panel (e) is an inverse-FFT image in which individual L'12-type ordered nanodomains are highlighted by red circles and are dispersed throughout the field of view.
The figure carries scale bars of 100 nm for the STEM-EDS maps, 2 nm for the HRTEM and inverse-FFT images, and 20 nm for the dark-field image.
The citing text states that statistics of VC precipitation on BF-TEM images gave an average VC size of 19.9 +/- 6.2 nm with a volume fraction of 0.26%; this value is not printed on the figure.
